Hope you had a good evening! Here is your recap of what we covered today.

We spent most of our time on the home lab backup script. You asked how to test restoring just one file from a snapshot without risking overwriting existing data, and I provided the steps using `rsync` and suggested adding `--dry-run`. I added this process to your **Home Lab Backup** note under "Restore test," and set a reminder for 8:00 PM tonight so you remember to actually run the test.

On the logistical side, we started by checking that Canberra was expected to be mostly sunny at 23°C today. I also pulled up your calendar showing three main blocks: the standup this morning, lunch with Dev at noon, and the sprint review in the afternoon. When it came to reminders, I initially set a reminder for car rego but you confirmed that wasn't necessary.

When it came to quick ideas, we looked at vegetarian lunches—I suggested making a halloumi wrap with rocket and hummus. Finally, when you asked about the Dickson bike shop opening hours, I wasn't able to find reliable details, so I let you know it might be best to ring them directly.
